name: two-column-sign-in
title: Two-column sign-in
description: A full-page sign-in with the form on one side and a quiet brand panel with a customer quote on the other, folding to the form alone on a phone.
docs: onSubmit({ email, password, remember }) signs the person in: return a message to show it in one announced error region above the fields (That email and password do not match), or nothing when it worked; a thrown error shows a general message. The button is busy while it runs and a second submit is ignored, and what was typed survives a failed attempt (the password field is focused and selected so it can be retyped). A missing or malformed field is told under the field. providers is a slot above a labelled divider (dividerLabel) for single sign-on and passkey buttons, forgotHref adds the Forgot password link, brand is your logo, footer sits under the form, and titleAs is h1 (the default, when the form is the page) or h2. aside is the other column for a quote, a product shot or a photo: it is hidden below lg and decorative (hidden from assistive technology) unless you give it asideLabel, so a phone gets the form alone in a column no wider than 24rem. Its top edge is level with the form column's, so a row of your own that is 2.5rem high lines up with the brand. It uses semantic tokens only, with a hairline between the halves and no gradient behind the quote. heading, description, submitLabel and labels change the words.
